ExperienceLauterbrunnen\\

Experience one of the highest free-falling waterfalls in Europe: The Staubbach Falls in Lauterbrunnen plunge 297 meters into the depths. Plan your trip.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/staubbach-falls-free-falling-waters-with-a-mist-of-spray/)

- [**Camping Jungfrau**\\
\\
AccommodationLauterbrunnen\\
\\
Popular holiday park at the foot of the mountains Jungfrau, Mönch and Eiger, Schilthorn and the Staubbach waterfall. Terraced campsite with a view onto the mountains. Pitches for tents, motorhomes and caravans, but motorhomes and chalets are also available for rent. Modern sanitary facilities, supermarket offering fresh, regional products. Restaurant, railway tickets, ATM at the info desk. Open all year.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/camping-jungfrau/)
- [**E-bike tour to the waterfalls in Lauterbrunnen**\\
\\
OfferInterlakenMarch 31, 2027\\
\\
This guided e-bike tour takes you from Interlaken to the Valley of the 72 Waterfalls. You'll ride with motor assistance along the Lütschine River to the Staubbach Falls and Trümmelbach Falls.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/e-bike-tour-to-the-waterfalls-in-lauterbrunnen/)
- [**Hike Lauterbrunnen - Stechelberg**\\
\\
RouteLauterbrunnen\\
\\
A total of 72 waterfalls gush down into the Lauterbrunnen Valley from the vertical cliff faces, some of which are as high as 400m. The roar and rush of these unique natural spectacles accompanies hikers on this picturesque trail from Lauterbrunnen to Stechelberg.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/valley-of-the-72-waterfalls-lauterbrunnen-stechelberg/)

\\
RouteLauterbrunnen\\

Opposite the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau mountains, the route continues, going through Mürren, past the cosy Rotstockhütte and up to the Sefinenfurgge Pass with its spectacular views. This takes hikers into the Kien Valley, where the long descent to Griesalp begins. A stage that offers a bit of everything.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/via-alpina-1_12/)
